findings.title: create API 400 names the configured bind IP to a creator-tier caller
findings.description: When AGENT_SSH_BIND_ADDRESS is a specific interface IP that is not assigned at create time, crud.py raises HTTPException(400, detail=...) whose text includes that IP. POST /api/agents is require_role("creator"), so a creator learns the host's VPN/interface address.
findings.exploit_scenario: A creator-tier user times agent creates during a VPN outage and reads the tailnet address of the Trinity host from the 400 detail.
findings.impact: Disclosure of a private-range interface address to an authenticated platform user who already reaches the host; no privilege change; only on a non-default configuration.
findings.recommendation: Accept. Alternative: keep the IP in the log line and drop it from the HTTP detail.
findings.verifier: sequential (single LOW finding; no independent agent spawned)

hypotheses.title: sshd started by a grant keeps running after the key expires until the next boot (and only stops then if ssh_access_enabled is off)
hypotheses.why_not_a_finding: the key line is removed at expires_at by the cleanup sweep; the port is loopback for containers this change creates; a cleanup_service extension could stop sshd when the last key expires
